title: The Cat in the Hot Sun
lines: The cat sits in the hot fog.
"A tub is not in the sun," said Kim.
Kim gets a tub from Dad.
Mud is in the tub. She rubs and rubs.
Kim rips a bag and tips bits in the tub.
The cat hops in and sits on the bits.
"The cat has a tub," said Dad.
Kim sits at the tub. The cat is in it.
scoring_note: This passage says "is not". Decodability forbids apostrophes. A child who reads "isn't" is reading for meaning — do not score it an error.
